summary: Selects a string from one of three string tables using a circular index read from a global input object, then copies the resolved string into the output buffer with a bound. The index is computed from a field at dword_7C54E0 + 0x4040: incremented and wrapped so the dispatch value cycles 0,1,2. Index 0 and the default branch use off_5CCBF0, index 1 uses off_5CCBE8, index 2 uses off_5CCBEC. For each branch the selected table is binary-searched against byte_5EC4C0 with byte_5EC4CC as the result buffer; a successful non-null match is strcpy'd into byte_5EC4CC, otherwise byte_5EC4CC is null-terminated empty. Finally sub_587DD0 copies at most a2-1 bytes from byte_5EC4CC into the output buffer a1, a NUL terminator is written at a1[a2-1], and 0 is returned.

operations.description: Reads the selection field at dword_7C54E0 + 0x4040, adds 1, and wraps a stored value of 2 back to 0, producing the circular dispatch index v2 in {0,1,2}.
Dispatch on the circular index: v2==0 uses the off_5CCBF0 table, v2==1 uses off_5CCBE8, v2==2 uses off_5CCBEC, and any other value falls back to off_5CCBF0.
Index-0/default branch: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, off_5CCBF0[0], byte_5EC4CC) searches the selected table and reports whether the entry exists.
Index-1 branch: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, off_5CCBE8[0], byte_5EC4CC) searches the off_5CCBE8 table.
Index-2 branch: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, off_5CCBEC[0], byte_5EC4CC) searches the off_5CCBEC table.
When the binary search succeeds and the selected table entry is non-null, the entry is strcpy'd into the shared result buffer byte_5EC4CC.
When the selected table entry is null or the lookup fails, byte_5EC4CC is cleared by writing zero to its first byte.
sub_587DD0(a1, byte_5EC4CC, a2 - 1) copies at most a2-1 bytes from the resolved string in byte_5EC4CC into the output buffer a1.
Writes a NUL terminator at output position a1[a2-1], bounding the copied string.
